Open Day and Mornings
Bookings now open - Join us for Open Mornings!
A Place to Grow in Faith, Learning, and Love.
Are you ready to unlock your child's full potential? Come and see what makes St Columba’s a place where curiosity thrives, creativity blossoms, and excellence is nurtured every day.
Mid-week Open Morning tours start at 9.30am on the following dates;
Tuesday 13th October 2026 Wednesday 14th October 2026 Thursday 15th October 2026
To book Open Morning tours email admissions@st-columbas.co.uk with your preferred date, your sons name and his current primary school and we will confirm your booking, limited spaces available!
Your child’s future starts here. We can't wait to meet you!
St Oscar Romero Catholic Academy Trust
Responding to the call of the Gospel, we provide a distinctive Catholic Education, steadfast in our commitment to collaboration, professional development, and community partnerships. By working together, we can overcome challenges, celebrate achievements, and create a vibrant family of schools where every child can flourish
